Nearly eight hours ended by manual extinguishing; it is not a fuel exhaustion time.

designatedFacts.fact: The description claims more than six hours per fill.
designatedFacts.quote: each fill provides more than 6 hours of ambiance.
designatedFacts.qualification: This is a product-description claim, not a measured average. The source does not specify fuel, wick setting, weather or test conditions.

designatedFacts.fact: One reviewer reports five to six hours after lighting.

designatedFacts.qualification: This is one customer report. It does not explicitly establish a full initial fill, test conditions or a population average, and it is shorter than the description claim.

designatedFacts.fact: Another reviewer reports nearly eight hours of burning before manually extinguishing the torches.
designatedFacts.quote: they burned beautifully all night (for nearly eight hours before i blew them out).
designatedFacts.qualification: The customer extinguished the torches; this is not an eight-hour exhaustion limit or a measured average. Initial fill and operating conditions are not stated.
